property_summary: After deploying C, calling forward with some data and an arbitrary callee address succeeds in the reference (calling the callee) but reverts (or behaves differently) in the bug because the bug calls owner instead, and owner is the contract itself without a fallback, causing a revert.
change_summary: Replace 'callee.call(_data)' with 'owner.call(_data)' so that the call is always to the contract owner instead of the specified callee.
